text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. delivered a performance that sent 
shockwaves through the venue. Some in the 
crowd began hoping she might one day 
become a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Mr. C.B. wanders freely 
across mountains and riverbanks. With no 
destination in mind, her route seems to 
change purely on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For future reference, the Trainer wanted 
to be able to predict her moods. Thus, 
they began accompanying her on her walks 
to gain a deeper understanding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Tazuna appeared and asked what 
her next target race would be. Mr. C.B. 
expressed her wish to race against strong 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their next goal is set: the Kyodo News 
Hai, a prep race for the spring Classics.
